title: 第一章 第一次刷新变废为宝第二章 四天连蹦三级炼气四层
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
鹤咏仙门，合欢堂
“仙女，真的不行了……我要被榨干了！”
精致的闺房内，一名仙女赤身骑在周荒身上，身体还在有规律的做着律动。
周荒此刻看去上不太好，眼神内陷，炯炯无神，面色枯荣，显然是被榨的不能再榨了……
反观仙女林语嫣，脸上浮现一抹潮红，俏脸变得越来越精致，尽显妩媚之色。
终于，一个时辰后。
林语嫣满脸厌恶自周荒身上离开，穿上青纱衣，变回了原来那副娇艳模样。
“哼，真是个废物。才三个时辰就不行了！”
听到这话，躺在床上无力动弹的周荒真想跳起来给她一巴掌。
榨了我这么久，阳气几乎吸干，就算没有功劳也得有苦劳吧，最后就给我留下这么一句话。
然而，想归想，他还是没那个勇气反抗。
闭上双眼，周荒越想越气。
他简直倒了八辈子血霉，才穿越到了这个修仙界了？
早知道上辈子就不加班了，睁眼便来到了此方修仙界。
几年前，当他得知这个世界可以修仙时，他简直异常高兴，毕竟谁不想做一个御剑持宝的仙人呢。
可是，现实给了他一个大大的巴掌。
五行废灵根就像一座大山般压在他的身上，让他这辈子都喘不过气来。
可现在修仙的那股劲还在，他不想放弃。
于是来到了鹤咏仙门，想着先从一个杂役做起，岂不了刚来一段时间，便被合欢堂的林语嫣给看上了。
周荒若是没记错，这已经是对方第三次榨干自己了，而且是…每周一次。

若下周还来，周荒觉得自己真的可以先去阎王那报道一下了。
“金钱子，滚进来。”
门口，林语嫣欣然说道，看得出老她很高兴，因为如果她感觉没错的话，只需要下周再采补周荒一次，便可彻底突破。
随着他话音落下，一名体重至少两百斤开外的大胖子走了进来。
“仙女，小的在。”
“嗯。”林语嫣冷声应答一句，而后指了指床上的周荒说道：
“给他扔到废丹房一周，别让他死了，本仙女下周还要用。”
说完，他将几枚灵石扔在脚下。
“小的办事，您放心。”
金钱子一脸阿臾的说道，而后跪下来将几枚灵石全部揣进兜里。
下一秒，床上的周荒只觉一阵天旋地转，就被金钱子背在了身上，出了闺房。
半个时辰后，周荒被金钱子一把扔在了废丹堂外。
随后，金钱子将一瓶丹药，以及一枚木牌扔到了周荒脸上。
“别以为傍上了仙女就能出头了，还敢让金爷爷背着你，你脸大了！”
“这一周将身体给我养好，下周林师姐还要用。”
“还有，不要给我偷懒，该做的工给我做好！”
“否则！”
content_en:
Heyongxianmen, Hehuan Hall
"Fairy, I really can't do it anymore... I'm going to be drained dry!"
In the exquisite boudoir, a fairy was riding naked on Zhou Huang's body, her body still moving regularly.
Zhou Huang doesn't look good at the moment. His eyes are sunken and dull, and his face is withered. It's obvious that he has been squeezed and can't be squeezed anymore...
On the other hand, fairy Lin Yuyan had a flush on her face, and her pretty face became more and more delicate, showing her charm.
Finally, an hour later.
Lin Yuyan left Zhou Huang with disgust on her face, put on the green gauze clothes, and returned to her original charming look.
"Humph, what a waste. It's only been three hours and it's already gone!"
After hearing this, Zhou Huang, who was lying on the bed unable to move, really wanted to jump up and slap her.
After squeezing me for so long, my yang energy has almost been sucked dry. Even if there is no credit, there must be hard work. In the end, I left you with this sentence.
However, thinking about it, he still didn't have the courage to resist.
Closing his eyes, Zhou Huang became angrier as he thought about it.
It took him eight lifetimes of bad luck to reach this world of immortality?
If I had known that I would never work overtime in my previous life, I would have arrived in this world of immortality when I opened my eyes.
A few years ago, when he learned that one could cultivate immortality in this world, he was extremely happy. After all, who doesn't want to be an immortal who wields a sword and holds a treasure?
However, reality gave him a big slap in the face.
The Five Elements Wasted Spiritual Roots were pressing down on him like a mountain, making him breathless for the rest of his life.
But now the energy to cultivate immortality is still there, and he doesn't want to give up.
So I came to Heyongxianmen, thinking about starting as a handyman, but not long after I came here, I was attracted by Lin Yuyan from Hehuan Hall.
If Zhou Huang remembered correctly, this was already the third time that the other party had squeezed him dry, and it was... once a week.
If he comes again next week, Zhou Huang feels that he can really go to the King of Hell to report first.
"Qianzi, come in."
At the door, Lin Yuyan said happily. She could tell that she was very happy, because if she felt right, she would only need to pick up Zhou Huang again next week to achieve a complete breakthrough.
As he finished speaking, a fat man who weighed at least two hundred pounds walked in.
"Fairy, the little one is here."
"Yeah." Lin Yuyan responded coldly, then pointed to Zhou Huang on the bed and said:
"Throw him into the waste elixir room for a week. Don't let him die. This fairy will use it next week."
After speaking, he threw a few spirit stones at his feet.
"It's a small matter, don't worry."
Qianzi said with an expression on his face, then knelt down and put all the spiritual stones into his pocket.
The next second, Zhou Huang on the bed felt dizzy for a while, and was carried out of the boudoir by Qian Zi on his back.
Half an hour later, Zhou Huang was thrown outside the Waste Pill Hall by Qian Zi.
Afterwards, Qianzi threw a bottle of elixir and a wooden sign into Zhou Huang's face.
"Don't think that you can get ahead by hanging out with a fairy. You dare to let Grandpa Jin carry you on his back. You are so embarrassed!"
"Give me good health this week. Senior Sister Lin will need it next week."
"Also, don't be lazy for me, do the work that needs to be done for me!"
"Otherwise!"
